entities.name: Norwegian Crown & the Black Death
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Iceland under the Norwegian crown after the Old Covenant, the erosion of the Althing's power, the Black Death's devastating impact (killing perhaps half the population), and the transition to Danish sovereignty via the Kalmar Union (1397).
